UTF-8 text plus original attachment base64 and JSON framing have an exact byte-estimator boundary; one byte less blocks the entire Wake source without send or cursor.

Four fresh process connections prove cursor UPDATE failure rolls back all exposure state while preserving the immutable backend receipt; restart repair and exact receipt replay do not duplicate facts.
A late trusted transport receipt remains historical exposure after permission revocation; it grants neither another send nor a forged member delivery authority.
Restart recovery preserves unknown transport as a replay barrier with no message exposure or delivery cursor.
A member starting after a same-wave early answer retains the original cutoff while still receiving its own authorized private history.

The process workers use the production evidence verifier and recovery code, but do not run index.ts, a native SDK or a real supplier.
